name: default_statistics_target
description: Sets the default target number of histogram bins and most-common-values entries collected by ANALYZE for table columns without column-specific statistics targets.
symptoms: Suboptimal join order or join method
Unexpected sequential scans instead of index scans
tuning_tips: Increase for large tables with skewed data distributions to improve planner accuracy; reduce if ANALYZE time is excessive and plans are already acceptable. Test changes with EXPLAIN and monitor plan stability.
